about: The storybook the clients are held to: every whole screen a person reaches, in each state that changes how the screen is put together. One piece in one variant (a row kind, an ask card, a message inside an otherwise identical screen) is a component example instead. A story the terminal or the phone lacks says why; the Mac's screens are still being designed, so it lists only the stories it draws. The terminal's storybook is crates/shot/src/stories.rs; the phone's stories are examples of apps/apple/Amux/Debug/ComponentCatalog.swift, which nothing checks against this list; the Mac's are apps/apple/Packages/AmuxMacScreens/Sources/AmuxMacStories/Stories.swift. The terminal's and the Mac's tests check their storybooks against this list.
